deferred.claim: Cast Desolation of Smaug: deal 3 damage to each non-Dragon creature, then add four mana in any combination of colors, spendable only to cast Dragon spells.
deferred.basis: Desolation of Smaug deals 3 damage to each non-Dragon creature. ... Add four mana in any combination of colors. Spend this mana only to cast Dragon spells.
